fonts.title: Typography
fonts.help: Use one family for a consistent interface. Listings and preview can differ. Choose a suggestion or type an installed font and press Accept. Unavailable fonts fall back to a system alternative.
refresh.panel: Refresh this panel (F5 in the active panel)
refresh.all: Refresh all panels, expanded branches and drives
retry.title: Retry failed files
retry.help: Only failed copy/move files; successful steps and folders are not repeated. Review the paths. Conflicts will be prompted. This retry does not record undo.
retry.changed: Files changed during review. Close and review again.
retry.invalid: Cannot prepare retry. Check paths and permissions.
recipes.title: Operation recipes…
recipes.help: Gather files, filter and prepare a delivery. Recipes save criteria, never files or this run's paths. Opening or saving never executes anything.
recipes.name: Recipe name
recipes.roots: This run's roots, one absolute path per line. Relative layout requires a single root. Not saved in the recipe.
recipes.destination_help: New folder or ZIP within the destination. {date} becomes the local date when preparing. Originals are never moved or overwritten. Up to 5,000 files; an incomplete query blocks delivery.
recipes.loaded: Document loaded. Review parameters and prepare before executing.
recipes.steps: Gather → filter → propose names → new delivery. Review paths before executing.
recipes.rows_limit: View limited to the first 500 names; the delivery manifest will include all.
recipes.partial: The query was incomplete or reached the limit. Narrow the criteria and check permissions before preparing.
recipes.files_only: Selection mode accepts regular files, not folders or links. Use a query to gather subfolders.
recipes.invalid: Could not prepare or save. Check the name, parameters and destination; scripts and overwriting existing destinations are not allowed.
points.title: Comparison points…
points.help: Saves metadata, not files: this is not a backup. Up to 50,000 entries / 32 MiB per point. SHA-256 reads content and may take time; you can cancel. Opening a point does not scan folders.
points.exclusions: Exclude relative paths, one per line (up to 64, no wildcards). A folder excludes its entire subtree. Links are skipped.
points.delete_confirm: Click “Recycle point” again to confirm. ONLY the .naygopoint file shown below will be removed, not the files in the scanned folder.
points.basket_help: Select with checkboxes (Tab / Space). Only present added or modified files are eligible. Prepare a delivery from the basket. Missing and unknown items are informational.
points.complete: Full coverage of the configured scope.
points.partial: Partial coverage: unexamined areas, links, errors or limits. Missing files cannot be inferred there. This is not an atomic disk snapshot.
points.rows_limit: Showing the first 5,000 changes. Totals include all results; narrow the scope to select the rest.
points.version: Unsupported point version. No files were changed.
points.limit: Point exceeds its limit (50,000 entries / 32 MiB / 8 MiB of paths). Narrow the scope.
points.changed: The document changed or roots/scopes are incompatible. Open it again; it is not replaced automatically.
points.invalid: Invalid point or scope. Use an absolute root and relative exclusions without “..” or wildcards.
points.exported: Copy exported; the original point remains active.
points.recycled: Point recycled. Scanned files were not changed.
queries.title: Saved queries / multiple folders…
queries.help: Save criteria, not results (.naygosearch). Loading does not search. Search scans now; there is no index or automatic refresh. Results are a snapshot.
queries.name: Query name
queries.roots_help: Absolute folders: one per line (up to 64). Overlapping roots are scanned once when recursive.
queries.forget: Remove reference from Ctrl+P / workspace (does not delete file)
queries.limit: Query exceeds the supported limits (64 roots, 256 KiB).
queries.invalid: Check the name, absolute paths and sizes: nonnegative integers, minimum ≤ maximum.
queries.saved: Query saved. It has not been executed.
queries.loaded: Criteria loaded. Review folders and press Search to execute.
queries.forgotten: Reference removed. The file is unchanged.
spaces.title: Task workspaces
spaces.help: Save panes, paths, columns, filters and basket references in a .naygospace file. Files, searches and operations are not included. The file supplies the name; saving is explicit.
spaces.root_help: Optional root: when saving as, every path must be inside it. When opening a relative workspace, it replaces the original root. Leave blank to retain saved paths. Update keeps the active workspace's root.
spaces.working: Working… Reading this document does not execute saved navigation or file operations.
spaces.unnamed: Session without a saved task workspace
spaces.dirty: Changes not saved to a task workspace.
spaces.confirm: This replaces the current layout and basket. Save first to retain them. Running operations continue. Path availability is not checked here.
spaces.version: Unsupported workspace version. The file was not modified.
spaces.limit: Workspace exceeds limits (4 MB, 64 panes or 10,000 references).
spaces.outside_root: Paths are outside the selected root, or you are trying to rebase a workspace saved with absolute paths.
spaces.changed: The file changed outside Naygo. Open that version or save as a different file.
spaces.exists: File already exists. Choose another name or Update the open workspace.
spaces.io: Could not read or save the workspace.
spaces.staging: There are temporary drag-and-drop references. Copy them into a real folder and replace their basket references before saving.
delivery.group_names: Source names: one per line, in list order. Keep file extensions.
delivery.rename: Propose unique names for all duplicates (flat mode)
delivery.conflicts: Conflicting output names; adjust groups or enable unique names, then review again
delivery.hash: Verify SHA-256 (additional reads of originals and copies)
delivery.title: Prepare delivery
delivery.help: Review before publishing. Creates a NEW destination, keeps originals and includes a manifest and list. By default, verification uses size and date, not a hash. Review shows up to 500 entries.
delivery.destination: Full path of the new destination
delivery.waiting: Queue mode: wait for current operations to finish.
basket.scope: Copy/move/delete/deliver: marked items. Ctrl+A: all. Remove keeps originals.

settings.packs.hint: A pack activates a theme and an icon set together.
settings.save_default_table.hint: Saves the active panel's visible columns, their order and widths as a template for new panels.

shell.error: The operation could not be completed
slint.help.title: Naygo help
slint.help.intro: Naygo is a fast, Commander-style file explorer. Almost everything works from the keyboard; the panel with the accent border is the active one.
slint.help.panels: ＋ splits the panel; “Panel ▾” adds tree/properties/etc. Drag a panel's title bar onto another to rearrange; drag the dividers to resize (you see a ghost bar of the edge).
slint.help.nav: Double-click or Enter enters; Backspace/← goes up; Alt+←/→ back and forward; F5 refreshes; Tab switches panes. Type the first letters to jump to an item (typeahead).
slint.help.cols: Click a header to sort (▲/▼); right-click opens sort/filter/move/hide. Filters by name, extension (with counts), size and date. A funnel marks filtered columns.
slint.help.ops: Ctrl+C/X/V copy/cut/paste; Del trash; F2 rename; Shift+F2 batch rename; F6 move to the other pane; Ctrl+Z undo. Right-click: open a terminal in the folder.
slint.help.layouts: The Layouts button applies/saves panel arrangements. Settings (draggable) cover appearance, shortcuts, paste, advanced and About. Shortcuts are edited there.

batch.help.text:
{name}    original name (without extension)
{ext}     original extension (with "template includes the extension")
{n} {n:3} counter (padded to 3 digits)
{day} {month} {year}  file modification date
{hour} {min} {sec}    file modification time
Unknown wildcards are left as-is.

preview.pdf.no_text: (Could not extract text: this may be a scanned, protected or image-only PDF.)
slint.cfg.tip.show_parent: Shows a «..» row at the top of each pane to go up to the parent folder with one click.
slint.cfg.tip.icon_only: Shows toolbar buttons with their icon only, no text, to save space.
slint.cfg.tip.bar_position: Places the toolbar on top (horizontal) or on the side (vertical).
slint.cfg.tip.size_no_subdirs: When computing a folder's size, does not descend into subfolders (faster, but the total is partial).
slint.cfg.tip.autostart: Starts Naygo automatically when the computer powers on (on Windows sign-in).
slint.cfg.tip.autostart_minimized: When Naygo starts with Windows, it launches hidden in the system tray, without showing any window. Requires start-with-Windows and the tray icon.
slint.cfg.tip.default_table: Uses the active pane's columns as the default for new panes.
slint.cfg.tip.ops_mode: Queue runs one operation at a time; Parallel allows several at once.
slint.cfg.tip.confirm_trash: Asks for confirmation before sending files to the recycle bin.
slint.cfg.tip.confirm_drop: Asks what to do (copy/move) when dragging files between panes.
slint.cfg.tip.show_op_summary: Shows a summary when a file operation finishes (how many, errors).
slint.cfg.tip.paste_confirm: Asks to confirm the name before creating the file when pasting text or an image.
slint.cfg.tip.paste_name: Name template for pasted text. {fecha} is replaced by the current date and time. It is the only available token.
slint.cfg.tip.paste_ext: Extension of the file created when pasting text (for example: txt, md).
slint.cfg.tip.theme: Choose the color theme. Applied live. «Customize» opens the editor to create your own.
slint.cfg.tip.icon_set: Choose the icon set. Applied live. «Customize» jumps to the Icons tab.
slint.cfg.tip.animations: Enables extra animations (such as the operations panel progress-bar glow). They use a little more CPU.
slint.cfg.tip.date_format: Format used to display file dates in the panes.
slint.cfg.tip.size_format: Unit used to display sizes. Automatic picks the most readable one for each size.
slint.cfg.tip.row_density: Height of the pane rows. Compact shows more files at once.
slint.cfg.tip.shortcuts: Click «Change» and press the new combination. «Reset» restores the factory shortcut.
slint.cfg.tip.export_lang: Export the active language as a .naygolang file to share or edit it.
slint.cfg.tip.export_theme: Export the active theme as a .naygotheme file to share or edit it.
slint.cfg.tip.export_config: Export all your settings as a .naygoconf file to back them up or move them to another machine.
slint.cfg.tip.import_lang: Import a language from a .naygolang file.
slint.cfg.tip.import_theme: Import a theme from a .naygotheme file.
slint.cfg.tip.export_icons: Export the active icon set as a .naygoset file to share it.
slint.cfg.tip.import_icons: Import an icon set from a .naygoset file.
slint.cfg.tip.ops_display: Where operation progress is shown: in a docked panel, a modal dialog, or always visible.
slint.cfg.tip.paste_image_fmt: PNG: lossless, ideal for screenshots. JPG: lossy, smaller files, better for photos.
slint.cfg.tip.low_power: Reduces CPU usage on machines without a dedicated graphics card. Automatic decides based on the machine.
slint.cfg.tip.new_items_at_end: Files created during the session appear at the end of the list instead of being re-sorted.
slint.cfg.tip.tray_enabled: Shows a Naygo icon in the system tray (next to the clock).
slint.cfg.tip.close_to_tray: When closing the window, Naygo hides in the system tray (leaves the taskbar) instead of quitting. Bring it back with the tray icon, the global shortcut, or by launching Naygo again.
slint.cfg.tip.global_hotkey: A key combination that shows Naygo and brings it to the front from any application. The Windows key cannot be used.
slint.cfg.tip.recent_limit: How many visited folders the history keeps. Accepts 1 to 100.
slint.cfg.tip.footer_enabled: Shows an info line at the bottom of each pane (selection, totals, disk space).
slint.cfg.tip.footer_template: What the footer shows. Pick a ready-made template or «Custom…» to write your own with tokens.
slint.cfg.tip.footer_custom: Footer template. Available tokens: {sel} {total} {marked} {free} {disk_total} {pct} {items} {files} {dirs}. They are replaced by the pane's data.
slint.cfg.tip.home_dir: Folder opened when Naygo starts. Empty = your personal folder.
slint.cfg.tip.factory_reset: Resets ALL settings to factory defaults. This cannot be undone.
slint.cfg.tip.auto_highlight: Automatically highlights code syntax in the preview, based on the extension.
slint.cfg.tip.preview_table: Which extensions are previewed and with what view mode. «View mode» lets you treat a custom extension as another type (for example, .sif as XML code).
slint.cfg.tip.icon_set_base: The app's base icon set. One click applies it live to all objects.
slint.cfg.tip.icon_objects: Change the icon of a specific object. «Change» picks another set or your own PNG just for that object.
slint.cfg.tip.icon_custom: Import or export a full icon set (.naygoset), or reset all icons to the base set.
